literal: One's own life even if departing, do not do oneself another's sweet life removing action.
translation: Even if one were to lose one's own life, one should never perform an action that takes away the sweet life of another being.
modern: தன் உயிர் உடலை விட்டுப் பிரிவதாக இருந்தாலும், ஒருவன் மற்றொரு உயிரினத்தின் இனிய உயிரைப் போக்கும் செயலைச் செய்யக் கூடாது.
explanation: This couplet establishes the absolute and uncompromising nature of non-violence. It instructs that even if one's own life is at stake, one must not perform any action that destroys the life of another creature. The term 'இன்னுயிர்' (sweet life) emphasizes that existence is precious and dear to every living being. By prioritizing the life of others over one's own survival, the text sets an ultimate standard of compassion.
